Usage: oci bds block-storage [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Adds block storage to existing worker/compute only worker nodes. The same
  amount of storage will be added to all worker/compute only worker nodes. No
  change will be made to storage that is already attached. Block storage
  cannot be removed.  [Command Reference](addBlockStorage)

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  For detailed help on any of these individual commands, enter
                  <command> --help.

Commands:
  add  Adds block storage to existing worker/compute only worker nodes.
